name: Natsujimai Fuyujitaku
source:
After working for a week, I, Shirasu Gonbee, have screwed up in-store operations.

As a result, I ended up being relocated to the materials department by the store manager.
Apparently, my new job was to work in a unified warehouse for the same chain stores in the same vicinity.
A supporter, for the Deputy Material Manager currently working there alone.

When I followed the floor manager, who was my direct boss for a week, to the warehouse...
There stands Kurokawa Sayaka - Deputy Material Manager, a woman of the same age as me.

The moment we met, marks the beginning of a daily-life story. 
A simple scenario, without any particularly splendid events or brilliant settings.

[Translated from the [url=http://wosakana.com/NJFJ/story.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
工作一周后，我，Shirasu Gonbee，把店内运营搞砸了。

结果，我最终被店长调到了物资部。
显然，我的新工作是在同一地区同一连锁店的统一仓库工作。
支持者，目前独自在那里工作的材料副经理。

当我跟着楼层经理，也就是我一周的直属上司，来到仓库的时候……
那里站着黑川沙耶香——材料副经理，一位与我同龄的女性。

我们相遇的那一刻，标志着日常生活故事的开始。
一个简单的场景，没有什么特别精彩的事件或者绚丽的场景。

[翻译自[url=http://wosakana.com/NJFJ/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
